name: patient_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kilograms_per_square_meter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kilograms per square meter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no BMI value in kilograms per square meter is available for the patient at the current time or if the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured or calculated BMI value in kilograms per square meter if available for the patient at the current time.

name: patient_body_weight_value_recorded_now_withunit_kilograms
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body weight in kilograms.
when_unknown: Set to null if no body weight in kilograms is available for the patient at the current time or if the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured body weight in kilograms if available for the patient at the current time.

name: patient_body_height_value_recorded_now_withunit_meters
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body height in meters.
when_unknown: Set to null if no body height in meters is available for the patient at the current time or if the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured body height in meters if available for the patient at the current time.

name: patient_bmi_calculated_from_weight_and_height_now_withunit_kilograms_per_square_meter
meaning: BMI calculated from weight and height at the current time in kilograms per square meter.
when_unknown: Set to null if either body weight or height is not available, or if BMI is directly available.
when_value: Set to the value calculated as body weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters, if both are available and BMI is not directly available.

name: patient_meets_bmi_requirement_now
meaning: Indicates whether the patient meets the BMI requirement (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m²) at the current time.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's BMI (measured or calculated) is greater than or equal to 30 kilograms per square meter at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's BMI (measured or calculated) is less than 30 kilograms per square meter at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if BMI cannot be determined from available data.

name: patient_has_history_of_unsuccessful_dietary_effort_to_lose_body_weight
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of at least one unsuccessful dietary effort to lose body weight.
when_true: Set to true if there is documentation or reliable report that the patient has made at least one dietary effort to lose body weight in the past, and that effort was unsuccessful (i.e., did not achieve intended weight loss).
when_false: Set to false if it is documented or reliably reported that the patient has never made a dietary effort to lose body weight, or all such efforts were successful.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of unsuccessful dietary effort to lose body weight.

name: patient_number_of_unsuccessful_dietary_efforts_to_lose_body_weight_in_the_history
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of unsuccessful dietary efforts to lose body weight in the patient's history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many unsuccessful dietary efforts to lose body weight the patient has made.
when_value: Set to the number of distinct unsuccessful dietary efforts to lose body weight documented or reliably reported in the patient's history.

name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kilograms_per_square_meter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kilograms per square meter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no BMI measurement is available for the patient now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured BMI value in kilograms per square meter if a measurement is available for the patient now.
